rows.reasoning: Pierce's only record is a Nay on SB 1(ss) (2022), which makes abortion 'a criminal act, except when performed under the following circumstances' (health/life, lethal anomaly, rape or incest). A No on that bill rejects only the bill's own position: it may come from members who want fewer limits or from those who want no exceptions, so it does not separate the sides or reach any rung's clauses (for example 'keep abortion legal at every stage of pregnancy, with no time limit'). No own words are in the sources.
